The '''Salvage Bandit Camp''' was a base of operations of the [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Salvage bandits]] in the south-western part of the [[Crystal Flats/Legends|Crystal Flats]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found old recordings of a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Mustafar)|Jedi Knight]] in this camp.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Salvage Bandit Camp appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
